channel.title: TrueSquare Remodel blog
channel.description: Bathroom remodeling guides for Seattle homeowners.

item.title: Does a bathroom remodel add value in Seattle in 2026?
item.description: The newest Cost vs Value data (2025 edition) says a midrange Seattle bathroom remodel recoups 46.8% at resale, against 91% for the Pacific region.

item.title: Asbestos in a Seattle bathroom remodel: what the rules say
item.description: Old sheet vinyl and some other bathroom materials can contain asbestos. What the Puget Sound Clean Air Agency and L&I require ahead of demolition.

item.title: Do you need a permit for a bathroom remodel in Seattle?
item.description: Yes, when plumbing, wiring, walls or the layout change. Which Seattle agency issues which permit, the 2026 plumbing fees, and what skipping a permit costs.

item.title: Bathroom remodel permits in Seattle, Renton, Bellevue and King County
item.description: Who issues the building, plumbing and electrical permit for a bathroom remodel in Seattle, Renton, Bellevue and King County, and where the rules differ.

item.title: Why your Seattle bathroom estimate has a 10.55% sales tax line
item.description: Washington charges retail sales tax on the full remodel contract. Here is why it is a separate line, which rate applies to your city, and how to check it.
